title: AGCP Normative Companion Reference Dispositions
purpose: Resolve repository references that name normative companion artifacts not present in the controlled release and bind each retired label to existing canonical artifacts.

dispositions.rationale: The v2.0.1 controlled repository contains no standalone security companion. Security-relevant obligations remain distributed across the published CRs, Core, adopted companion specifications, schemas, and registries. The retired label does not identify an artifact and shall not be used as a normative reference.

The v2.0.1 controlled repository contains no standalone governance-evidence companion. Normative evidence obligations are established by the CRs and Core and serialized through DS-020 Governance Evidence and DS-033 Evidence Qualification Result, with provenance and ledger continuity supplied by the published companion specifications.

retired_labels: Governance Approval and Human Adjudication Specification
dispositions.canonical_title: AGCP Human Adjudication and Governance Approval Specification
dispositions.rationale: The referenced artifact exists, but the reversed title is noncanonical. References shall use the exact controlled title and repository path.

reference_rules: Normative references shall identify an existing controlled repository path or an explicitly identified external normative source.
A subject-area label shall not be written as though it were a standalone normative artifact when no such artifact exists.
Distributed normative obligations shall reference the applicable controlling artifacts rather than an invented umbrella specification.
Historical records may preserve retired labels only when clearly identified as historical or disposition metadata.
